calibration.source: 32,976 owned random-entry 60-minute quote paths over 251 sessions under the declared stop-or-hold law; exported 2026-08-15 from quoted_exit_paths.parquet

decision_rule.binding: Only PREFLIGHT_PASSED satisfies kill condition 1 of the signed reopening; any failure keeps the real fit refused.

development_probes_disclosure: Before freezing, outcome-blind synthetic probe grids ran under seed prefixes 'timing-probe', 'probe-grid' and 'null-probe-t4' to calibrate effect_slope_minimum and trades_per_session_target. The campaign seed bank ('drawdown-preflight-v1') is disjoint from every probe prefix, honoring the capacity-campaign no-seed-reuse rule.
question: Can the exact drawdown-ordered lifecycle pipeline — 48-parameter compact_interaction_entry trained under the production law on the clean-run label (+50% before -30% within 60m), frozen rank+floor selector, serial one-position account, full gate with session bootstrap at alpha 0.05/3 and 4/5 chronological blocks — recover a planted minimum-size edge in >=80% of trials with zero full-gate false passes across 60 null worlds?
sensitivity_statement: The planted minimum (slope 0.10, selector target 4/session) realizes ~52% selected precision against the 31.8% base. A passing preflight therefore certifies the real experiment can detect edges of roughly +20pp precision lift; a real negative rules out edges of that size and NOTHING SMALLER. Break-even (+2.4pp) remains far below the detectable floor, as the reopening's section 2 requires stating.
